title: Run the licence check in CI
goal: The licence check runs on every PR
acceptance: The check is in `check:fast` and in `ci.yml`; the run is green on `main`
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One workflow step and a green run. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
